preconditions.expression: len(good_letters) >= 1 and len(good_letters) <= 26 and good_letters.islower() and good_letters.isalpha() and len(set(good_letters)) == len(good_letters)
preconditions.description: The first line contains a string of 1 to 26 distinct lowercase English letters representing good letters.

preconditions.expression: len(pattern) >= 1 and len(pattern) <= 100000 and pattern.count('*') <= 1 and all(c.islower() or c in '?*' for c in pattern)
preconditions.description: The second line contains a pattern of length 1 to 10^5 containing lowercase letters, '?', and at most one '*'.
The third line contains an integer n between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(q) >= 1 and q.islower() and q.isalpha() for q in queries)
preconditions.description: The following n lines contain non-empty strings of lowercase English letters.
The total length of all query strings does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(line in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No'] for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i].upper() == 'YES') == matches_pattern(good_letters, pattern, queries[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each query string, the output is 'YES' if and only if the pattern matches the query string according to the rules: '?' matches any good letter, '*' matches any string (including empty) of bad letters, and literal letters must match exactly.
